reason: 该插件面向用户的核心用途是应用项目启动自动化：它通过表单收集项目需求与偏好、进行校验后在本地生成项目初始结构与上下文文件，并可选进行本地 Git 初始化，然后将任务以 Plan/Go 方式交接给当前 Harness 会话继续开发。依据仓库说明与代码组织，功能集中于脚手架与工作流衔接，而非独立执行复杂外部服务或远程代码提交。

summaries.zh: EasyCode 是一款面向 DeepSeek Harness 的应用启动器，用户可通过表单快速生成项目初始文件与上下文，并将其接入后续开发流程。
summaries.en: EasyCode is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets users quickly scaffold an initial project with form-based setup and hand it into an ongoing development workflow.

capabilities: collects project setup input from user forms
generates local project scaffold files and directories
supports temporary workspace staging before final project publish
optionally initializes a local Git repository
creates an initial task handoff to DeepSeek Harness session

reasons.code: README describes form-based project/stack/workflow collection, validation, and workspace preparation before development handoff
README lists generated artifacts (README.md, PLAN.md, EASYCODE.md, .easycode/config.json, optional .mcp.json) indicating local file creation behavior
README states project is first written to a temporary path and then moved to final location, and supports Plan/Go task forwarding
Repository tree shows scaffolder.ts, templates.ts, and validation.ts, consistent with local scaffold generation logic
